tweet_text:
sometimes i wake up, look at my phone, and instantly feel overwhelmed by the pull to absorb more info. so im building the opposite: a way to revisit things that already inspired me (a graph of the @AREdotNA channels i follow)
visually it's hugely inspired by CAIDA's walrus: a constant imagery of flowers of knowledge

references.name: Are.na
references.evidence: Mentioned in the tweet text as '@AREdotNA' and explicitly displayed in the network graph node labels such as 'How do you use Are.na?' and 'are.na moment'.

references.name: CAIDA's Walrus graph visualization
references.evidence: Directly cited in the tweet text as the visual inspiration and matches the 3D hyperbolic graph structure shown in the keyframes.

result.one_line: An interactive 3D network visualization tool designed to map and revisit connected Are.na channels in a spherical hyperbolic space.
